title: The Fixed-Rate Interest Base on Home Comfort Financing Accounts
content:
*Billing operations standard — Home Comfort Financing fixed-rate plans.*

**§1.** The fixed-rate interest base leaves out charges that are not principal: where the most recent payment on the account was returned, the base is the account balance less the most recent interest charge and less every late fee and returned-payment fee posted less than one whole month before the date of handling; where the most recent payment was not returned and such fees were posted in that month, the base is the account balance less those fees; otherwise the base is the account balance; a base below zero counts as zero.

**§2. Meanings.** The most recent payment *was returned* when a returned-payment entry on the account is dated on or after the posting date of the most recent payment. *The most recent interest charge* is the amount of the latest interest line; on an account with no interest line, nothing is taken off for it. *Such fees* are the late fees and returned-payment fees posted less than one whole month before the date of handling.

## Branches

| Most recent payment returned | Late or returned-payment fees in the last month | Fixed-rate interest base |
|---|---|---|
| yes | any | balance less the most recent interest charge, less those fees |
| no | yes | balance less those fees |
| no | no | balance |

Every branch stops at zero: a result below zero is taken as zero.

## Worked cases (hypothetical, balance $9650.00 on the date of handling)

- Most recent payment returned; returned-payment fee $15.00 and late fee $25.00 in the last month; most recent interest charge $61.20. Base: $9650.00 less $61.20, less $15.00, less $25.00: $9548.80.
- Most recent payment returned; no fee in the last month; most recent interest charge $61.20. Base: $9588.80.
- Most recent payment not returned; returned-payment fee $15.00 in the last month. Base: $9635.00.
- Most recent payment not returned; no fee in the last month. Base: $9650.00.
